warnings.title: Minor Flood Warning for Bulloo River to Quilpie and Bulloo River at Quilpie
warnings.description:
Minor flooding is likely along the Bulloo River at Quilpie

The Bulloo River at Quilpie is currently at 2.79 m and rising, below the minor flood level. The Bulloo River at Quilpie is likely to exceed the minor flood level (3.00 m) Wednesday evening. The river may reach around 3.40 m Thursday evening, with minor flooding.
warnings.area: Queensland: Bulloo River to Quilpie and Bulloo River at Quilpie

warnings.title: Minor Flood Warning for Barcoo River to Isisford and Barcoo River at Blackall
warnings.description:
Minor flooding is estimated to be occurring along the Barcoo River at Blackall.

No observations are currently available for the Barcoo River at Blackall. Based on the nearby automatic gauge the river level is estimated to be above the minor flood level and slowly rising. The Barcoo River at Blackall may peak near 2.40 m Wednesday afternoon, with minor flooding. The river is likely to remain above the minor flood level (2.00 m) for the remainder of Wednesday and during Thursday.
warnings.area: Queensland: Barcoo River to Isisford and Barcoo River at Blackall

warnings.title: Flood Warning for Warrego River to Charleville and Warrego River at Charleville
warnings.description:
Flooding is occurring along the Nive River and Warrego River to Charleville, with minor flooding occurring at Biddenham and The 27 Mile Garden.

The Warrego River at Charleville is currently at 1.73 m and rising, below the minor flood level. The Warrego River at Charleville may peak near 3.70 m overnight Thursday into Friday, just below the minor flood level (4.0 metres).
warnings.area: Queensland: Warrego River to Charleville and Warrego River at Charleville
